description: Sustainable mineral resource management involves the responsible extraction, use, and conservation of mineral resources to meet present needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. An important component of this approach is the use of Earth observation technologies, which allow the detection of (critical earth) minerals, continuous monitoring of mining activities, land degradation and water quality. The development of novel EO solutions and tools improve transparency, support better decision-making, andhelp detect unsustainable practices in near real time. Combined with recycling, resource efficiency, and strong environmental policies, Earth observation enhances the ability to balance economic development with environmental protection and social responsibility,ensuring long-term sustainability of mineral resources.
